notes_for_editor: Thin record. The two State Archives maps place the tower in Township 11, Range 3, Washington County, and show it existed in 1925 and 1929. The association list gives status and coordinates. No build date, staffing, fires, or removal date found. A Facebook search snippet describes the tower as in extreme eastern Maine, but the fetched page returned no text, so it is not used. The State Archives view page for the 1929 map (digitalarchives.maine.gov/view/2416) has no location or fire details. Used 2 WebSearch calls and 4 page reads.
